ei.title: The Origin of the Dream Catcher
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Long ago, when the world was young, an old Native American spiritual leader Odawa had a dream on a high mountain. In his dream, Iktomi, the great spirit and searcher of wisdom, appeared to him in the form of a spider. Iktomi spoke to him in a holy language. Iktomi told Odawa about the cycles of life. He said, "We all begin our lives as babies, move on to childhood, and then to adulthood. Finally, we come to old age, where we must be taken care of as babies again." Iktomi also told him that there are good and bad forces in each stage of life. "If we listen to the good forces, they will guide us in the right direction. But if we listen to the bad forces, they will lead us the wrong way and may harm us," Iktomi said. When Iktomi finished speaking, he spun a web and gave it to Odawa. He said to Odawa, "The web is a perfect circle with a hole in the center. Use the web to help your people reach their goals. Make good use of their ideas, dreams, and visions. If you believe in the great spirit, the web will catch your good ideas and the bad ones will go through the hole." Right after Odawa woke up, he went back to his village. Odawa shared Iktomi's lesson with his people. Today, many Native Americans have dream catchers hanging above their beds. Dream catchers are believed to filter out bad dreams. The good dreams are captured in the web of life and carried with the people. The bad dreams pass through the hole in the web and are no longer a part of their lives.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) spiritual=영적인, (B) appeared=나타났다, (C) holy=신성한
det.analysis:
❌ ① worldly — appeared — holy: (A) worldly(세속적인)는 영적 지도자 spiritual과 반대
❌ ② spiritual — vanished — holy: (B) vanished(사라졌다)는 꿈속에 나타난 appeared와 반대
✅ ③ spiritual — appeared — holy: 원문 일치. 영적인(spiritual) 지도자, 거미의 모습으로 나타난(appeared) Iktomi, 신성한(holy) 언어라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ spiritual — appeared — ordinary: (C) ordinary(평범한)는 신성한 언어 holy와 반대
det.tip: a spiritual leader(영적인) / appeared to him(나타났다) / a holy language(신성한)

det.korean: (A) guide=인도하다, (B) harm=해치다, (C) perfect=완벽한
